pages.title: Ancient Remnant
pages.text: $(bold)Cataclysm's desert: the Ancient Remnant's wrath of the desert, its sandstorm and necklace, ancient metal, the khopesh and koboleton bones, and the dungeon stone of every Cataclysm ruin.$(br2)$(thing)Ashen Age$(n), ring 9.$(br)$(thing)40 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Warrior.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill the Ancient Remnant$(n)$(br2)Pays 8 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
